tasks.title: Design and implement streak tracking system
tasks.description: Create the logic for tracking user streaks, including incrementing streaks on daily habit completion and resetting them when a habit is missed.
tasks.done_criteria: Streak tracking system is implemented and tested in the app with no visible bugs in the UI/UX for streaks.

tasks.title: Implement smart reminder logic
tasks.description: Develop the algorithm for smart reminders, which should consider user behavior, habit frequency, and time of day to suggest optimal reminder times.
tasks.done_criteria: Smart reminder logic is implemented and tested with a variety of user scenarios, and the reminders are shown at appropriate times.

tasks.title: Update UI for streaks and smart reminders
tasks.description: Revise the app's UI to display streaks clearly and integrate smart reminders into the user flow, ensuring they are easy to manage and customize.
tasks.done_criteria: UI for streaks and smart reminders is updated and tested, with no visual or usability issues.

tasks.title: Prepare app for App Store and Google Play submission
tasks.description: Ensure the app meets the submission guidelines for both platforms, including app metadata, screenshots, and compliance with content policies.
tasks.done_criteria: App is ready for submission to both App Store and Google Play with all required assets and metadata in place.

tasks.title: Submit app to App Store and Google Play
tasks.description: Complete the submission process for both platforms, including uploading the app, filling out the store listing, and waiting for approval.
tasks.done_criteria: App is successfully submitted to both App Store and Google Play and is in the review queue.

tasks.title: Analyze Crash Reports and Identify Common Causes
tasks.description: Review Firebase Crashlytics reports to identify the most frequent crash causes and prioritize them based on impact and frequency.
tasks.done_criteria: A list of top 5 crash causes with their frequency and impact is documented and shared with the team or self-reviewed for accuracy.

tasks.title: Fix High-Impact Crash Causes
tasks.description: Implement fixes for the most critical crash causes identified in the previous task, ensuring they are resolved and tested thoroughly.
tasks.done_criteria: All high-impact crash causes are resolved and verified through testing and crash reporting.

tasks.title: Implement Crash Prevention and Recovery Mechanisms
tasks.description: Add robust error handling, recovery mechanisms, and logging to prevent crashes and improve resilience in edge cases.
tasks.done_criteria: Crash prevention and recovery mechanisms are implemented and tested in the app, with no new crash reports introduced.

tasks.title: Monitor and Validate Crash-Free Sessions
tasks.description: Use Firebase Crashlytics to monitor crash-free sessions and validate that the crash-free percentage has reached 99.5%.
tasks.done_criteria: Crash-free sessions metric is confirmed to be at or above 99.5% in the Firebase dashboard.

tasks.title: Launch a referral program to incentivize user growth
tasks.description: Design and implement a referral program that rewards users for inviting friends to join the app. Include a clear call-to-action in the app and on the website.
tasks.done_criteria: Referral program is live and visible to all users with clear instructions on how to invite friends and earn rewards.

tasks.title: Implement a social media campaign to attract new users
tasks.description: Create and execute a social media campaign targeting potential users, using platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Twitter. Focus on showcasing the app's value and user testimonials.
tasks.done_criteria: Social media campaign is launched with at least 3 posts per week and a clear tracking mechanism for user sign-ups.

tasks.title: Optimize onboarding flow to improve user retention
tasks.description: Revise the onboarding process to ensure new users understand the app's core features and are guided through the setup process effectively.
tasks.done_criteria: Onboarding flow is updated and tested with a sample of users, showing improved engagement and retention.

tasks.title: Analyze user behavior to identify growth opportunities
tasks.description: Use Firebase analytics to track user behavior, identify drop-off points, and determine which features are most engaging to users.
tasks.done_criteria: User behavior report is completed, highlighting key insights and actionable recommendations for growth.

tasks.title: Implement a rating system for stores
tasks.description: Design and implement a system for users to rate stores within the app. This includes UI for rating submission, backend storage, and display of average ratings.
tasks.done_criteria: The rating system is fully implemented and tested, with average store ratings being displayed correctly in the app UI and stored in Firebase.

tasks.title: Collect and analyze user feedback
tasks.description: Collect user feedback on store ratings and use it to identify common pain points or areas for improvement. Analyze the data to understand what drives higher ratings.
tasks.done_criteria: User feedback has been collected and analyzed, and a summary report is provided with insights on how to improve store ratings.

tasks.title: Improve store features based on feedback
tasks.description: Implement changes to store features based on the feedback analysis, such as improving navigation, adding more customization options, or enhancing the user experience.
tasks.done_criteria: All identified improvements have been implemented and tested, and the app is updated with the new features.

tasks.title: Monitor and track rating improvements
tasks.description: Monitor the average store rating over time and track progress toward the target of 4.4 stars. Use Firebase analytics to measure changes in user behavior and satisfaction.
tasks.done_criteria: The average store rating has increased to 4.4 stars, and the progress is documented with analytics data showing the trend.

tasks.title: Analyze current free-to-paid conversion funnel
tasks.description: Review user behavior data to identify bottlenecks in the free-to-paid conversion funnel, including drop-off points and user motivations.
tasks.done_criteria: A detailed analysis report is completed, highlighting key drop-off points and user motivations in the conversion funnel.

tasks.title: Design and implement A/B test for pricing options
tasks.description: Create and deploy a pricing experiment with two variants (e.g., $4.99/month vs. $9.99/month) to test which pricing model drives higher conversion rates.
tasks.done_criteria: The A/B test is deployed and running with clear metrics for tracking conversion rates.

tasks.title: Track and analyze A/B test results
tasks.description: Monitor the performance of the pricing experiment, collect data on conversion rates, and identify which variant performs better.
tasks.done_criteria: A report with the results of the A/B test is completed, including which pricing variant performed better.

tasks.title: Refine pricing strategy based on test results
tasks.description: Use insights from the A/B test to refine the pricing strategy, including adjustments to pricing tiers, promotions, or messaging.
tasks.done_criteria: A refined pricing strategy is documented, including any changes to pricing tiers or messaging.

tasks.title: Implement changes and monitor conversion rates
tasks.description: Deploy the refined pricing strategy and monitor the free-to-paid conversion rate over time to ensure it meets the target of 3%.
tasks.done_criteria: The refined pricing strategy is implemented, and the free-to-paid conversion rate is being monitored for improvement.

tasks.title: Design and Set Up Pricing Experiment
tasks.description: Create two pricing variants for the subscription model (e.g., $4.99/month vs. $9.99/month) and set up the experiment in the app with a randomized split of users. Ensure the experiment is configured to track conversion rates and user behavior.
tasks.done_criteria: The pricing experiment is set up and running with two variants, and user allocation is randomized and tracked in the analytics system.

tasks.title: Collect and Analyze Experiment Data
tasks.description: Gather data from the experiment over a period of 4 weeks, including conversion rates, user engagement, and retention metrics for both pricing variants. Use Firebase Analytics and any internal tracking tools to compile the results.
tasks.done_criteria: All relevant data from the experiment is collected, and preliminary analysis is complete, showing key metrics for both pricing variants.

tasks.title: Write Decision Memo Based on Experiment Results
tasks.description: Draft a written decision memo summarizing the experiment results, including statistical significance, user behavior insights, and a recommendation on which pricing variant to adopt. Ensure the memo is clear, data-driven, and actionable.
tasks.done_criteria: The decision memo is written and includes all necessary data, analysis, and a clear recommendation for the pricing model.

tasks.title: Finalize and Review Decision Memo
tasks.description: Review the decision memo for clarity, accuracy, and completeness. Ensure it aligns with the goals of the key result and is ready for final approval or implementation.
tasks.done_criteria: The decision memo is finalized, reviewed, and ready for implementation or sharing with stakeholders.
